Build dependencies (not committed):

- `logisim-evolution-5.0.0-all.jar`: original GPL v3 application.
- `logisim-evolution-5.0.0-source.zip`: corresponding original source, included in source downloads.
- `temurin-linux-x64.tar.gz`: official Temurin 21 Linux x64 JRE, checksum verified before packaging.
- `temurin-windows-x64.zip`: official Temurin 21 Windows x64 JRE, checksum verified before packaging.

Original release: https://github.com/logisim-evolution/logisim-evolution/releases/tag/v5.0.0
JRE metadata: https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/21/hotspot
